incident.source_message_en: Red Rainstorm Warning Signal is in force. Due to wet weather and slippery roads, Transport Department appeals motorists and the commuters to: i. plan the journey in advance; ii. allow more traveling time; iii. drive with extra care and patience; and iv. take heed of traffic situation particularly at busy junctions with obstructive views.
incident.source_message_zh: 紅色暴雨警告信號現已生效，天雨路滑，運輸署呼籲駕駛人士及乘客須: i.提早計劃行程路線； ii.預留充裕時間出門； iii.小心駕駛及保持忍讓；及 iv.留意交通情況，特别在視線受阻的繁忙路口。
incident.notes: The message is about a weather warning and general driving advice, not a specific incident on a road.

incident.source_message_en: The Transport Department announces that the traffic on Sai Kung Man Yee Road leading to High Island Reservoir East Dam is anticipated to be quite busy in general. The operator of Green Minibus Route No. 9A will strengthen its service to cater for passenger demand as necessary. Members of the public are advised to plan ahead their journeys, reserve sufficient commuting time, and be patient while queuing.
incident.source_message_zh: 運輸署表示，通往萬宜水庫東壩的西貢萬宜路交通預計一般比較繁忙，專線小巴第9A號線的營辦商會按需要加強服務應付乘客需求。請遊人妥善規劃行程，預留充裕交通時間，同時在輪候時保持忍讓。
incident.notes: The incident is due to heavy traffic, not a road closure. No direction specified.

incident.source_message_en: As informed by the Chinese Mainland Railway Authorities, the following High Speed Rail train trips will be cancelled due to expected adverse weather conditions: From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Shanghai Hongqiao Station: G900 From Shanghai Hongqiao Station to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station: G899 For the latest train schedules, please refer to the official website (12306.cn) or the mobile app. You may also check the latest service updates on the HSR website, mobile app or see the information available at Hong Kong West Kowloon Station. You may also consider using travel on the East Rail Line trains to Lo Wu/ Lok Ma Chau or use other transport to enter the Chinese Mainland. For ticket refunds, please refer to the information on the High Speed Rail website and process within the stated time. To obtain a refund, please use the 12306 official website (12306.cn) or mobile app. Unless you require assistance, there is no need to go to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station.
incident.source_message_zh: 中國內地鐵路單位通報，由於預期天氣情況惡劣，下列高速鐵路列車車次取消： 由香港西九龍站前往上海虹橋站：G900 由上海虹橋站前往香港西九龍站：G899 有關車次的資料，請留意12306官方網站(12306.cn)，如已安裝手機應用程式，可按「車站大屏」頁面。您亦可留意於高速鐵路網頁、手機應用程式或香港西九龍站發放的最新資訊。 您可考慮乘搭東鐵綫經羅湖/落馬洲，或使用其他跨境交通工具前往中國內地。 如需退票，請參閱高速鐵路網頁並於指定日期內辦理。請盡量使用12306官方網站(12306.cn)或手機應用程式，不用急於到香港西九龍站辦理。
incident.notes: The message is about High Speed Rail service disruption due to adverse weather, not a road incident. No road closure or lane closure mentioned.

incident.source_message_en: As informed by the Chinese Mainland Railway Authorities, the following High Speed Rail train trips will be cancelled due to adverse weather conditions: 11 July: From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Shanghai Hongqiao Station: G900, G902 From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Fuzhou Station: G920, G924 From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Guangzhounan Station: G6504 From Shanghai Hongqiao Station to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station: G899, G901 From Fuzhou Station to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station: G919, G923 From Guangzhounan Station to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station: G6503 12 July: From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Shanghai Hongqiao Station: G900, G902 From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Fuzhou Station: G920 From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Guangzhounan Station: G6504 From Shanghai Hongqiao Station to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station: G899, G901 From Fuzhou Station to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station: G919 From Guangzhounan Station to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station: G6503 For the latest train schedules, please refer to the official website (12306.cn) or the mobile app. You may also check the latest service updates on the HSR website, mobile app or see the information available at Hong Kong West Kowloon Station. For ticket refunds, please refer to the information on the High Speed Rail website and process within the stated time. To obtain a refund, please use the 12306 official website (12306.cn) or mobile app. Unless you require assistance, there is no need to go to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station.

incident.source_message_en: Due to malfunction of traffic lights at the junction of Hennessy Road and Tin Lok Lane, motorists are advised to drive with utmost care when passing through the road junctions, pay extra attention to the traffic signs and safety of pedestrians. Pedestrians please pay attention to vehicles when crossing junctions with malfunctioned traffic lights. At the same time, the Transport Department has received notification from Hong Kong Tramways Limited that the Happy Valley Loop tram service is suspended. Traffic is busy now.
incident.source_message_zh: 由於軒尼詩道和天樂里交界的交通燈失靈，駕駛人士在駛經有關路口時，請加倍小心，注意交通標誌的指示並留意過路行人的安全。行人在交通燈失靈的路口橫過馬路時，請特別注意車輛。 同時，運輸署接獲電⾞公司通知，跑⾺地圈的電⾞服務暫停。 現時上址交通繁忙。
incident.notes: The incident is related to traffic light malfunction, not a road closure. Tram service suspension is mentioned but not directly related to road closure.
